groups.contract: Server event registration and native source/recipient identity
groups.disposition: Both complete pinned bodies personally read. Server event registration wraps E in a native message adapter, uses postcard defaults unless explicitly customized, and mapped events decode then Entity-map before publication. Trigger drain queues actual E only after message acceptance. Local server delivery drains ToClients and respects All/AllExcept/Single; intentionally bypasses wire decode. make independent requires prior registration and panics on absent registry entry, explicit native registration precondition rather than proven current first-party ordering bug. Native SendTargets is authoritative recipient enum; deprecated SendMode alias is pinned upstream evidence, not authorization to edit dependency or preserve/add a first-party compatibility API.

groups.contract: Server buffers prepare serialization before insert; actual serializer failure is fatal expectation
groups.disposition: Server send iterates current cursor and relies on later local drain to prevent repeated publication. Independent send allocates fresh Vec, serializes fully then sends immutable Bytes clones to selected clients; buffered send allocates fixed native tick padding then inserts only after serialization returnsOk. Failed serializer cannot insert partial bytes on these local paths but send_or_buffer calls expect and therefore panics on callback Err. This is an explicit native invariant requiring actually registered first-party Serialize to support every published message. No concrete current server message with reachable failing serializer, network execution or panic witness established; keep codec candidate003 and first-party native-admission dependencies separate. Fixed RepliconTick::POSTCARD_MAX_SIZE padding is a native wire contract, not invented integer cap.

groups.contract: Tick queue and reconnect reset publish decoded values after acceptance
groups.disposition: Queued messages pop only when their replication tick<=update_tick; each owned message decodes before writing. New payload validates tick first, queues future messages without semantic decoding, and logs/discards malformed tick or body. This wrapper has no local queue cap; actual MessageQueue/transport/trusted server lifetime remains dependency, no resource-exhaustion allegation without concrete first-party producer. Missing mapped Entities are rejected and list cleared after successful custom decode; early callback Err can retain mapping context similarly to client path, requiring an actual failing registered mapper/context continuation witness. reset clears queued messages intentionally on disconnect, not a broken replay guarantee. Native tick comparison/wrap semantics remain owner dependency; no raw-u32 chronology imposed. No tests or transport sessions executed.
